author: private-claude
name: T01
source:
theorem T01 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N

author: private-claude
name: T03
source:
theorem T03 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T01]
  have a := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h1 h4
  have b := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ m.Du + m.Dv) h5
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0

author: private-claude
name: T04
source:
theorem T04 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S := by
  intro m N M hdet hu hv hM hN hneg
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have hS : m.S ≤ 0 := by omega
  have h1 : 0 < M * M * m.detJ := Int.mul_pos (Int.mul_pos hM hM) hdet
  have h2 : 0 ≤ M * N * (-m.S) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) hN) (by omega)
  have h3 : 0 ≤ N * N * (m.Du * m.Dv) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg hN hN) (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega))
  have key : m.modeDet N M = M * M * m.detJ + M * N * (-m.S) + N * N * (m.Du * m.Dv) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S

author: private-claude
name: T05
source:
theorem T05 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hd hM hN h hDD
  have key : N * (m.S * M) ≤ N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N) := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hN
  have hp : 0 < m.detJ * (M * M) := Int.mul_pos hd (Int.mul_pos hM hM)
  have e : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ * (M * M) - N * (m.S * M) + N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  rw [e]
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

author: private-claude
name: T06
source:
theorem T06 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h6 : m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N := Int.not_lt.mp h
  have h7 := T05 m N M h1 h2 h3 h6 h4
  exact absurd h7 (Int.not_lt.mpr (Int.le_of_lt h5))
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M

author: private-claude
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s h1 hp h2 h3 n hn
  have hn' : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have e1 : (n:Int)^2 = (n:Int)*(n:Int) := by simp [Int.pow_succ]
  have e2 : p^2 = p*p := by simp [Int.pow_succ]
  have h4 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int)*(n:Int) := by
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn' hn' (by omega) (by omega)
    simpa using this
  have h5 : 1 * s^2 ≤ ((n:Int)*(n:Int)) * s^2 :=
    Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 (Int.sq_nonneg s)
  have h6 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa using h5) h2
  have hN : Scope.modeN s n = ((n:Int)*(n:Int)) * s^2 := by
    unfold Scope.modeN; rw [e1]
  have hM : Scope.modeM p = p*p := by
    unfold Scope.modeM; rw [e2]
  have hM0 : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by rw [hM]; exact Int.mul_pos hp hp
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    rw [hN]; exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)) (Int.sq_nonneg s)
  have hle : m.S * Scope.modeM p ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * Scope.modeN s n := by
    rw [hN]
    have : m.S * Scope.modeM p ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s^2 := by
      rw [hM, ← e2]; exact h3
    exact Int.le_trans this h6
  exact Int.le_of_lt (T05 m _ _ h1 hM0 hN0 hle h2)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

author: private-claude
name: T08
source:
theorem T08 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hP hS
  have hD : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ*M^2 - m.S*N*M + (m.Du*m.Dv)*N^2 := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h1 : m.S^2*M^2 ≤ 4*(m.Du*m.Dv)*m.detJ*M^2 :=
    Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS (Int.sq_nonneg M)
  have h2 := Int.sq_nonneg (m.S*M - 2*(m.Du*m.Dv)*N)
  have key : 0 ≤ (m.Du*m.Dv) * m.modeDet N M := by
    rw [hD]
    grind
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h3 : 0 < -(m.modeDet N M) := by omega
  have h4 := Int.mul_pos hP h3
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M

theorem H02 : ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C < r * B := by
  intro r B C
  unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain
  omega
statement: ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C < r * B

author: private-claude
name: H03
source:
theorem H03 : ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C := by
  intro r₁ r₂ B C h1 hB hF
  have h := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hB
  unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain at *
  omega
statement: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C

name: H04

theorem H04 : ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁ := by
  intro r B C₁ C₂ h hf
  unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain at *
  omega
statement: ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁

author: private-claude
name: T09
source:
theorem T09 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M hD hDu hDv hM hN hlt
  refine ⟨T04 m N M hD hDu hDv hM hN hlt, ?_⟩
  have hP : 0 < m.Du * m.Dv := Int.mul_pos hDu hDv
  have key : m.modeDet N M = (m.Du * m.Dv) * N^2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M^2 := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
    grind
  have h1 : 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.modeDet N M < 0 :=
    Int.mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by omega) hlt
  have h2 : 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.modeDet N M
      = (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M) * (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M)
        - (m.S^2 - 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ) * M^2 := by
    rw [key]; grind
  have h3 : 0 ≤ (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M) * (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M) := by
    generalize (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M) = X
    rcases Int.le_total 0 X with h | h
    · exact Int.mul_nonneg h h
    · have h' : 0 ≤ -X := by omega
      have := Int.mul_nonneg h' h'
      have e : (-X) * (-X) = X * X := by grind
      rw [e] at this
      exact this
  have hM2 : 0 < M^2 := by
    have e : M^2 = M * M := by grind
    rw [e]; exact Int.mul_pos hM hM
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hc
  have h4 : 0 ≤ (4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ - m.S^2) * M^2 :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2

author: private-claude
name: T11
source:
theorem T11 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2 := by
  intro m p s h1 h2 h3 ⟨n, hn, hd⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h' : m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 := Int.not_lt.mp h
  have := T07 m p s h1 h2 h3 h' n hn
  exact absurd hd (Int.not_lt.mpr this)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2

author: private-claude
name: T12
source:
theorem T12 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M) := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7
  constructor
  · exact T03 m N M h1 h3 h4 h5 h6
  · exact T05 m N M h2 h5 h6 h7 (Int.le_of_lt (Int.mul_pos h3 h4))
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M)
